quests.title: The Milling Frolic
quests.summary: Gather a fiddler, a singer and a Gaelic speaker for a milling frolic, then face the bard.

steps.text: Ask the fiddler on Chebucto Street.
Ask the milling frolic singer by the inn.
Ask the Gaelic speaker by the Gaelic class, then return to the bard.

quests.reward: Milled tweed (a Frost charm), oatcakes, maple syrup and standing with Kin Abroad.
